work.abstract_text: We prove the empirical recurrence in R. H. Hardin's OEIS entry A185765, revision 9, sole FORMULA field (October 3, 2025; submitted February 3, 2011). It counts labeled (n+1)-by-6 binary arrays whose contiguous 2-by-2 blocks have unequal traces at horizontal and vertical neighbors. A row-pair transfer operator reduces the all-length assertion to three exact finite identities. The recurrence holds for every n >= 13 and fails at n = 12, where its residual is -4160. Its reduced rational generating function proves that nine is the least possible eventual recurrence order over Q. The same method proves the smaller-width recurrences and Colin Barker's conjectural generating functions in A185761-A185764, including his two-column closed form. Transposition, divisibility by eight, and rationality at every fixed width give further consequences for Hardin's bivariate table A185769.

work.title: Hardin's six-column trace recurrence and Barker's generating functions
